items.title: Beijing unveils blueprint for biomedical dominance by 2030
items.summary: Outlining a five-year biomedical plan, China wants to expand its global role beyond just pipeline innovation.

items.title: Telix to acquire ITM in deal worth up to $2.35bn
items.summary: Telix Pharmaceuticals has agreed to acquire ITM Isotope Technologies Munich in a transaction valued at up to $2.35bn, combining Telix’s operations with ITM’s radioisotope production business and late-stage treatment candidate ITM-11.

items.title: How DFE Pharma supports confident continuous manufacturing decisions
items.summary: DFE Pharma supports confident continuous manufacturing decisions with CM-ready excipients, non-GMP testing and expert support.

items.title: Sandoz and mAbxience agree on emicizumab biosimilar partnership
items.summary: Sandoz and mAbxience have signed a licensing, development and commercialisation agreement for a proposed emicizumab biosimilar candidate for haemophilia A.

items.title: FDA hearing: psychedelics launch needs balanced regulation without limiting access
items.summary: Psychedelics have become a clear priority for the FDA following an EO aimed at accelerating research and regulatory pathways to psychedelic treatments.
